I never know whether I should say "Agnostic" or whether I should say "Atheist". It is a very difficult question and I daresay that some of you have been troubled by it. As a philosopher, if I were speaking to a purely philosophic audience I should say that I ought to describe myself as an Agnostic, because I do not think that there is a conclusive argument by which one prove that there is not a God.

On the other hand, if I am to convey the right impression to the ordinary man in the street I think I ought to say that I am an Atheist, because when I say that I cannot prove that there is not a God, I ought to add equally that I cannot prove that there are not the Homeric gods.

None of us would seriously consider the possibility that all the gods of homer really exist, and yet if you were to set to work to give a logical demonstration that Zeus, Hera, Poseidon, and the rest of them did not exist you would find it an awful job. You could not get such proof.

Therefore, in regard to the Olympic gods, speaking to a purely philosophical audience, I would say that I am an Agnostic. But speaking popularly, I think that all of us would say in regard to those gods that we were Atheists. In regard to the Christian God, I should, I think, take exactly the same line.

[WP] Your friend committed suicide a few days ago. You suddenly get a message from him on Facebook that says, 'This is your fault. Fuck you.'

I had just gotten home from work. I work evenings so it was pretty late, somewhere around midnight. I was checking my email with some music going and Facebook open in the background in case I got a message. I hadn't planned to be on for too long, I had a test the next day. I closed out the YouTube tab that I had set to my playlist, but before I could close anything else I got a message on Facebook. I flipped over to the Facebook tab to tell the person I didn't have time to talk and that I was tired, but it was Mike.

The reason this was odd is because Mike was dead. You see, not even a week ago Mike had killed himself. Shot himself in the head with a pistol.

I check the message and all it says is "This is your fault. Fuck you."

I reply asking who it is.

"You should know damn well that this is Mike's brother. You killed Mike. I know you did."

I call Mike's brother, hoping to calm him down. He picks up and yells "What the fuck do you want, murderer?"

"Look, I didn't kill Mike. What happened to Mike was fucking tragic, and I'm sorry for you man, but I had nothing to do with it."

"You're a fucking liar and I'm going to expose you. Everyone will see you for what you are."

Mike's brother had been angry ever since the day his brother killed himself, but tonight was different. I convinced him to meet me at the Denny's outside of town to clear things up. It was close enough to both of us that we could walk there.

When I got there he was already at a table, seething mad. He glared daggers at me as I took my seat.Silently he took a sip of his coffee, still steaming from the kitchen. I started speaking "Look-" but stopped when he opened his mouth as if he were going to yell at me. He closed his mouth and gave me a look of upset confusion. I started again "Look man, I am so fucking sorry about Mike. He was a great guy. Always had a joke ready,always making people laugh and smile. It was a massive shock when he. . . did it. Sometimes you just can't see it in people. Sometimes they hide it. Man, I miss Mike and I know you do too. I don't know why he did it, no one does. I know you're trying to rationalize it some way, but I didn't do it. I'm sorry, man."

He looked at the table and started sobbing. "It's just so fucking hard, man."

I put my hand on his shoulder and said "I know bud."

He finished his coffee, set a few dollars down on the table and we left, heading in opposite directions. I got about three blocks away when I heard metal rattle behind me. I turned around and there was a gun in my face. The person holding it said "I killed my brother."

I recognized the voice. All I could muster was a wavering "What?"

He responded "Shot him him in the head. Wiped the gun down. Put it in his hand. Wrote a fake note. No one suspected anything."

"What the fuck? Why?"

He looked at the gun for a moment, then looked back at me and said "Because people liked Mike. Mike knew everyone. Mike had friends. Mike had a life. You don't even know my fucking name. If I had messaged you from my account you never would have responded." A tear trickled down his cheek. "Now I'm in too deep. Every time I close my eyes I see him smiling. I hear him laughing, like he did when he told a bad pun. You were right, it is fucking terrible what happened to him. And I did it to him." Mike's brother wiped tears away from his eyes.

I raised my hands up in front of me. "Hey, please put the gun down. You can get help. They'll get you help."

He thrusted the gun in my direction as he yelled "No! People already don't like me! If I've go to a psych ward what the fuck will they think of me then?" He started sobbing. "No. I am fucked. I am fucked. I am so fucked."

"Just calm down please. Put the gun down. You can get out!" I took a step towards him.

"No!" He yelled as he took a step backward. He put the gun to his temple.

"No, don't!" I yelled and lunged at him. I was too late. I heard the gun go off, and tackled his dead body.
